The role is accountable for administration governance, facilities management, infrastructure readiness, stakeholder management, vendor performance, statutory and regulatory compliance, crisis response, and operational continuity across airport and non-airport locations. Ensure all locations remain safe, compliant, operationally ready, and aligned with business requirements. Drive service excellence, governance, operational discipline, and standardization across the regional portfolio. Support business growth through administration readiness for new locations, workplace changes, infrastructure enhancements, and expansion initiatives. description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - Administration (East Region) Location: Kolkata 
 Job Purpose Responsible for leading Administration operations across the East Region, ensuring safe, compliant, efficient, and business-ready workplaces that support IndiGo's operational and growth objectives. The role is accountable for administration governance, facilities management, infrastructure readiness, stakeholder management, vendor performance, statutory and regulatory compliance, crisis response, and operational continuity across airport and non-airport locations. The incumbent will work closely with regional business leaders, airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, and service partners to ensure seamless operational support, high service standards, business continuity, and a positive workplace experience across the region. 
 Key Responsibilities Regional Administration Leadership Lead end-to-end administration operations across the East Region covering offices, airport facilities, operational bases, ticketing offices, cargo facilities, and other business support locations. Ensure all locations remain safe, compliant, operationally ready, and aligned with business requirements. Drive service excellence, governance, operational discipline, and standardization across the regional portfolio. Monitor regional priorities, operational risks, service issues, and infrastructure requirements, ensuring timely resolution and escalation. Support business growth through administration readiness for new locations, workplace changes, infrastructure enhancements, and expansion initiatives. Facilities & Infrastructure Management Oversee maintenance, housekeeping, workplace services, utilities, employee amenities, and infrastructure support across all locations. Manage facilities operating within critical, high-security, and operationally sensitive environments, ensuring adherence to airport, aviation, safety, and security requirements. Drive approved refurbishment, expansion, and workplace improvement initiatives. Oversee space utilization, workplace planning, and administration asset lifecycle management. Drive initiatives to enhance workplace experience, employee wellbeing, and service delivery standards. Ensure facilities consistently support business continuity, operational requirements, and employee productivity. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnering Act as the primary Administration interface for regional leadership teams, airport stakeholders, station teams, and corporate functions. Build and maintain effective relationships with airport operators, regulatory bodies, government agencies, local authorities, service providers, and key external stakeholders. Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Security, Operations, Engineering, Cargo, and other functions to support business objectives. Represent the Administration function in operational reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder discussions. Vendor Governance & Commercial Management Lead sourcing, onboarding, governance, and performance management of administration and facilities service providers. Negotiate and manage contracts and service agreements to ensure service excellence, compliance, and commercial value. Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, scorecards, periodic reviews, and corrective action plans. Drive cost optimization and budget discipline while maintaining required service standards. Support budgeting, expenditure monitoring, and cost visibility across the regional administration portfolio. Compliance, Risk & Governance Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, airport, safety, security, environmental, and company requirements. Maintain readiness for audits, inspections, certifications, and compliance reviews, ensuring timely closure of observations. Coordinate with internal teams, airport authorities, and regulatory agencies on compliance-related matters. Identify and mitigate operational, compliance, and infrastructure risks to safeguard employee safety and business continuity. Promote adherence to established SOPs, governance standards, and internal controls across the region. Crisis Management & Business Continuity Lead administration response during emergencies, infrastructure failures, operational disruptions, and crisis situations. Coordinate with airport authorities, emergency services, local agencies, service providers, and internal stakeholders to minimize operational impact. Drive contingency planning, escalation management, and business continuity preparedness across the regional portfolio. Implement corrective and preventive actions arising from incidents and operational disruptions. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate operational reporting, dashboards, records, and management reviews. Monitor service delivery, vendor performance, compliance status, and key operational metrics. Identify improvement opportunities and drive process simplification, standardization, and service enhancement initiatives. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop regional administration teams through effective performance management, capability building, and succession planning. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, service excellence, and continuous improvement. Conduct structured reviews of priorities and team deliverables to ensure alignment with business objectives. Qualifications Essential Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Preferred MBA / PGDM. Certification in Facilities Management, Workplace Management, Infrastructure Management, Project Management, Business Continuity Management, or related disciplines. 
 Desired Experience 12+ years of relevant experience in Administration, Facilities Management, Workplace Services, Corporate Infrastructure, Real Estate Operations, or Business Support functions within a large multi-location organization. Demonstrated experience managing geographically dispersed administration and facilities portfolios across multiple locations. Experience in aviation, airports, hospitality, logistics, infrastructure, manufacturing, retail, or other operationally intensive environments will be preferred. Experience in airport administration, aviation operations, or management of facilities within operationally critical and high-security environments will be preferred. Strong understanding of facility operations, compliance requirements, and business continuity practices. Proven experience managing relationships with airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, service providers, and key business stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen with experience in vendor management, contract administration, budgeting, and cost optimization. Demonstrated experience in crisis management, incident response, and business continuity support. Strong knowledge of the regional operating environment, stakeholder ecosystem, and local business landscape. Preference will be given to candidates with experience operating in the East Region. Knowledge of Bengali and/or other regional languages will be an advantage. Critical Competencies Functional Competencies Administration & Facilities Management Workplace Services Management Stakeholder Management Vendor & Contract Management Compliance & Governance Crisis Management & Business Continuity Budget & Cost Management Infrastructure Planning & Readiness Service Delivery Excellence Risk Management Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking Stakeholder Influence Collaboration & Relationship Management Decision Making Problem Solving Team Leadership Change Management Execution Excellence Customer & Service Orientation

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Export Logistics Manager/Senior Executive

 About the Role 
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Export Logistics Executive to join our international trade team. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end management of sea export shipments from pre-shipment documentation and customs clearance through to post-shipment banking formalities. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with export documentation, a solid understanding of Letter of Credit (LC) transactions, and the ability to coordinate seamlessly across shipping lines, freight forwarders, CHA agents, and bank teams.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Shipment Planning & Coordination 
 Plan and execute FCL / LCL sea export shipments across designated trade lanes.
 Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, and CHA agents for bookings, container allocation, and vessel scheduling.
¢ Monitor container movement from stuffing to vessel departure and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
¢ Handle 50+ TEU / month (volume as applicable to role level).
 
 Export Documentation 
¢ Prepare and verify all pre-shipment documents: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Shipping Bill, ARE-1 / ARE-3, SDF / GR forms.
¢ Coordinate with CHA for Shipping Bill filing on ICEGATE; resolve customs queries and amendments.
¢ Issue and manage Bills of Lading (B/L) Original, Surrender, Switch, and Telex Release.
¢ Prepare Bank Covering Letters and submit complete post-shipment document sets to the bank within stipulated timelines.
¢ Maintain document registers and ensure 100% compliance with DGFT / RBI export regulations.
 
 Letter of Credit (LC) Management 
¢ Scrutinise LC terms upon receipt; flag discrepancies and liaise with the buyer / issuing bank for amendments.
¢ Prepare LC-compliant document sets (Sight / Usance / Standby) adhering to UCPDC 600 guidelines.
¢ Coordinate with the negotiating bank for LC negotiation, bill discounting, and realisation of export proceeds.
¢ Maintain LC-wise tracking and ensure zero discrepancies in submissions.
 
 Compliance & Reporting 
¢ Ensure timely BRC (Bank Realisation Certificate) closure and EDPMS (Export Data Processing & Monitoring System) compliance.
¢ Liaise with auditors / DGFT for export obligations, advance licence, and EPCG licence matters.
¢ Prepare weekly / monthly MIS reports on shipment status, freight costs, and document TAT.
¢ Stay updated on changes in customs tariff, EXIM policy, and RBI circulars.
 
 Required Qualifications & Experience 
¢ Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field.
¢ 2 6 years of direct experience in export logistics / freight forwarding / international trade documentation.
¢ Proven hands-on experience with sea freight exports (FCL / LCL).
¢ Strong knowledge of export documentation: Shipping Bill, B/L, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, COO, Phytosanitary Certificate (as applicable).
¢ Working knowledge of Letter of Credit (LC) scrutiny, compliance, and negotiation.
¢ Familiarity with ICEGATE, EDPMS, and RBI / DGFT regulations.
¢ Good understanding of INCOTERMS 2020 (EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF, DDP).
¢ Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word); experience with ERP / trade management software is a plus.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
¢ Experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator) status procedures.
¢ Prior exposure to SEZ / bonded warehouse / deemed exports.
¢ Exposure to import-side documentation (Bill of Entry) for holistic supply-chain visibility.
¢ Working knowledge of EXIM trade finance instruments (Bank Guarantee, Standby LC, Buyers Credit).
¢ Certification in Export-Import Management (IIFT / FIEO / equivalent) is advantageous.
 
 Competency Framework

¢ Ability to negotiate freight rates

¢ Audit readiness and record management

¢ Opportunity to work across diverse trade lanes and commodity types.

¢ Collaborative work culture with cross-functional exposure (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain).
